plainText:
Anela (Japanese: モアニ Moani) is a recurring character in . She is a friend of Ash's Incineroar and runs a fruit stall in the Hau'oli City marketplace.

==History==
Anela debuted in First Catch in Alola, Ketchum-Style!, where she provided some . After spotting a flock of , , and fly overhead, she explained to Litten that the flock visits the market every year to collect food. Anela happily donated some fruit to the Pokémon.

In That's Why the Litten is a Scamp!‬, Anela provided Litten with some more Berries and explained to and that Litten does this every day.

In One Journey Ends, Another Begins..., Anela picked up a doughnut that had fallen out of Ash's bag. She went to give it back to Ash only for Litten to grab it and run off. Ash also visited her following 's disappearance. Anela gave him some Berries to deliver to Litten and instructed him to tell Litten it could come to the marketplace anytime.

Anela has attended multiple events at the Pokémon School, including the Family Visit Day in Alolan Open House! and the school play in Lillier and the Staff!.

 and often visit Anela's fruit stall, where she offers them and their Pokémon bowls of produce free of charge, like in The Ol' Raise and Switch! and We Know Where You're Going, Eevee!. In Alola, Alola!, she met who was visiting Alola and laughed after swallowed a watermelon whole.

She attended Professor Kukui and 's wedding in The Professors' New Adventure!.

In the banned episode SM064, Anela got to meet Litten for the first time after its Evolution into and gave it some Sitrus Berries to eat. She also witnessed a fight between two groups of .
 
In All They Want to Do is Dance Dance!, Anela's name was finally revealed by . Anela met Mallow and in the market place where she gave Steenee some fruit and watched as it danced. She went on to show Mallow the Hula Dance and brought out her to perform it on the street, which inspired Mallow and Steenee to do it for their upcoming Pokémon Dance performance. She was invited to the Pokémon School for a Pokémon Dance presentation, where it was revealed that she used to be a . She was later trapped by and watched as Steenee evolved into .

In Dummy, You Shrunk the Kids!, Anela offered an apple to a shrunken and his , before Ash and arrived at her stall.

In Securing the Future!, Anela joined the rest of Alola in showering with light so it could return to its .

In Living on the Cutting Edge!, Anela had her fruit cut by a . She later explained the incident to Ash, who was searching for Kartana. She then gave some sliced fruit to him and his Pokémon to enjoy.

==Character==
Anela has an affable and generous personality, as shown through her friendship with . She is a community-minded individual and enjoys an event-filled calendar outside of her role as a greengrocer. In Real Life...Inquire Within!, she delivered Berries to Nurse Joy after learning that she was unwell. Anela often gives , and their Pokémon bowls of fruit, free of charge, when they visit her stall. This comes from Anela's generous heart and her love and respect for nature, often citing that nature's bounty is for everyone to share and enjoy.
